findings.summary: The node's required artifact reviews/product-coherence.md does not exist anywhere. No reviews/ directory exists in the worktree or the main repo; git history has no commits touching reviews/*; the deterministic result reports artifacts_present={'reviews/product-coherence.md': False}. The node's entire role — a written whole-product review of the integrated aa-cli — is unfulfilled by this work.

The subject diff (e83122c..4ed59ee, the review-product-coherence attempt-0 result) contains only audits/tui-methodology.md — the required artifact of the upstream node tui-methodology-audit (tui-methodology-audit.yaml:31-32), not of review-product-coherence (review-product-coherence.yaml:34-35 requires reviews/product-coherence.md). The tip commit's own contribution is a 13-line citation fix to that upstream file. Accepting this diff as this node's result would (a) double-credit an upstream node's deliverable and (b) unlock audit-methodology-compliance (review-product-coherence.yaml:38) with no review in existence, breaking the deliberate review-before-audit ordering.

The node's dependency milestone-integration is still provisional (milestone-integration.yaml:33 status: provisional; deterministic result deps_status={'milestone-integration': 'provisional'}), and its only e2e evidence in the worktree is a stub run (.scratch/milestone-integration/e2e-state/runs/20260824T225209Z-29953/packet.json, state 'open', title 'e2e stub task'). review-product-coherence depends_on milestone-integration (review-product-coherence.yaml:13-14); a review of a product whose integration milestone is not accepted cannot legitimately gate the final audit.

integrity.reasoning: The node's intended role is to produce a written whole-product review of the integrated product (reviews/product-coherence.md) after milestone-integration completes and before audit-methodology-compliance runs. The work under review — the diff attributed to the review-product-coherence attempt-0 job — contains none of that. It adds only audits/tui-methodology.md, which is the required artifact of a different, upstream node (tui-methodology-audit); the review artifact itself does not exist in the worktree or the main repo. Meanwhile the node's dependency milestone-integration is still provisional, with only stub e2e evidence. Treating this diff as the node's completion would unlock the final audit with no review rendered and an unsatisfied dependency — directly violating the node's why ('don't audit a product the reviewer has just judged needs correction' — here there is no judgment at all) and the deliberate review-before-audit ordering. This is not a subtle veer (drift) nor a mere absence of evidence (insufficient); the evidence positively contradicts the node's stated deliverable, and accepting it would damage the graph's gate chain. Human review is required before any dependent (audit-methodology-compliance) fires.
